name: Ravi Nair
goals: Build a Kubernetes cluster observability platform
Create a CI/CD pipeline health dashboard
communication_style: Operational, SRE mindset, talks about SLOs/SLIs/error budgets, references Prometheus, Grafana, Terraform, Helm
pain_points: MTTR is 45 minutes, management wants it under 10 minutes
Terraform state drift causes weekly production incidents
Jenkins pipelines are a mess, 200+ jobs, nobody knows what half of them do
sample_prompts: Build a Kubernetes observability dashboard with Prometheus metrics, pod health, resource utilization, and SLO tracking per service
Create a Terraform drift detection system that runs every 30 minutes and sends Slack alerts when infrastructure diverges from desired state
Build a CI/CD pipeline health dashboard showing build success rates, deployment frequency, MTTR, and change failure rate per team
